claims.object_text: alpha subunit of the Kv2.1 voltage gated potassium channel
claims.quote: KCNB1, on human chromosome 20q13.3, encodes the alpha subunit of the Kv2.1 voltage gated potassium channel.

claims.object_text: ubiquitously expressed throughout the brain; critical in controlling neuronal excitability, including in the hippocampus and pyramidal neurons
claims.quote: Kv2.1 is ubiquitously expressed throughout the brain and is critical in controlling neuronal excitability, including in the hippocampus and pyramidal neurons.

Whole exome sequencing revealed a heterozygous variant of uncertain significance (c. 342 C>A), p. (S114R) in KCNB1, encoding a serine to arginine substitution (S114R) in the N-terminal cytoplasmic region of Kv2.1.

Functional investigation of Kv2.1-S114R using cellular electrophysiology revealed slowing of channel activation, deactivation, and inactivation, resulting in increased net current after longer membrane depolarizations.
The siblings' father demonstrated autistic features and was determined to be an obligate KCNB1 c. 342 C>A carrier based on familial genetic testing results.
